payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and metrics used to measure topic quality, particularly through the use of meta information and NPMI scores.

claims.text: Topic quality can be measured using Normalised Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) scores, which indicate topic coherence based on word co-occurrence.
Incorporating meta information into topic models improves topic quality, especially in cases of insufficient word co-occurrence information.
MetaLDA outperforms other models in terms of topic quality as indicated by higher NPMI scores on short text datasets.
